item.title: Getting started
item.description:
This example runs entirely on your machine: no identity provider and no external service. It uses the embedded dev provider, which is loopback-only and must never be used in production.

File

examples/getting-started/routes.json

{
 "authProvider": {
 "type": "dev",
 "loginBaseUrl": "http://login.demo.localhost:3000",
 "cookieDomain": "demo.localhost"
 },
 "routes": [{
 "host": "app.demo.localhost",
 "path": "/*",
 "frontend": true,
 "backend": "http://127.0.0.1:8080",
 "auth": {},
 "userBadge": {
 "position": "right",
 "claims": ["preferred_username", "email"],
 "logoutLabel": "Sign out"
 }
 }]
}

item.title: Multi-app SSO
item.description:
This example starts from one protected application and adds a second route behind the same authentication provider. That is what creates SSO: the provider and the shared cookie domain are already in place, and the second route reuses the same Gate One session.

Changing the provider alone does not create SSO. Adding a route alone does not create SSO either. The two routes must use the same provider and share the same cookie domain.

item.title: Cross-domain SSO
item.description:
This example puts two unrelated domains behind one IdP session. Each domain keeps its own Gate One cookie; no cookie crosses the TLD boundary.

Files

  • examples/cross-tld-sso/routes.json

  • examples/cross-tld-sso/README.md

Shared group, per-domain providers

{
 "ssoGroups": [{
 "id": "acme",
 "issuer": "https://idp.example.com/realms/acme",
 "clientId": "gate-one",
 "clientSecretEnv": "OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET",
 "sessionKeyEnv": "OIDC_SESSION_KEY",
 "sessionStore": {
 "type": "redis",
 "url": "redis://redis:6379/0",
 "prefix": "cladone:auth:v1:"
 },
 "providers": [
 {"id": "app-a", "loginBaseUrl": "https://login.app-a.com", "cookieDomain": "app-a.com"},
 {"id": "app-b", "loginBaseUrl": "https://login.app-b.fr", "cookieDomain": "app-b.fr"}
 ]
 }],
 "defaultAuthProvider": "app-a",
 "routes": [{
 "hosts": ["app-a.com", "app-b.fr"],
 "path": "/*",
 "frontend": true,
 "backend": "http://app:8080",
 "auth": {}
 }]
}

issuer, clientId, sessionStore and sessionKeyEnv are written once. Each provider entry only carries its domain, login host and optional cookie name. The route is written once; Gate One expands it to app-a.com and app-b.fr and binds each one to its provider.

item.title: Keycloak with Google
item.description:
This example uses Keycloak as the IAM and OIDC issuer, with Google as an additional identity provider inside Keycloak. Gate One only sees the Keycloak issuer; it does not configure Google directly.

browser -> Gate One -> Keycloak -> Google

item.title: Embedded IAM
item.description:
This example runs the optional embedded IAM cladone-auth as the single OIDC issuer for Gate One. cladone-auth federates Google and normalizes Google claims into the roles/scopes/claims Gate One enforces.

Files

  • examples/embedded-iam/broker.json

  • examples/embedded-iam/routes.json

Broker configuration

{
 "publicUrl": "https://auth.example.com",
 "listen": ":8081",
 "redis": {
 "url": "redis://redis:6379/0",
 "passwordEnv": "REDIS_PASSWORD",
 "prefix": "cladone:broker:v1:",
 "authPrefix": "cladone:auth:v1:"
 },
 "tenants": [{
 "id": "mycompany",
 "clientId": "gate-one",
 "clientSecretEnv": "MYCOMPANY_BROKER_CLIENT_SECRET",
 "redirectUris": ["https://login.example.com/auth/callback"],
 "upstreams": {
 "google": {
 "issuer": "https://accounts.google.com",
 "clientIdEnv": "GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID",
 "clientSecretEnv": "GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET",
 "hostedDomain": "example.com"
 }
 },
 "defaultRoles": ["user"],
 "allowedDomains": ["example.com"],
 "mappings": [
 { "claim": "groups", "values": ["admins"], "roles": ["admin"] }
 ]
 }]
}

mappings translates IdP-specific claims into the common model. The legacy groupRoles block is still accepted for the groups claim.

item.title: High Availability
item.description:
This example runs several Gate One replicas behind a load balancer and uses Redis as the shared OIDC session/revocation store. It is the multi-instance variant of the multi-app SSO example.

File

examples/high-availability/routes.json

{
 "authProvider": {
 "type": "oidc",
 "issuer": "https://auth.example.com/realms/mycompany",
 "clientId": "gate-one",
 "clientSecretEnv": "OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET",
 "loginBaseUrl": "https://login.example.com",
 "cookieDomain": "example.com",
 "sessionKeyEnv": "OIDC_SESSION_KEY",
 "sessionStore": {
 "type": "redis",
 "url": "redis://redis:6379/0",
 "passwordEnv": "REDIS_PASSWORD",
 "prefix": "cladone:auth:v1:"
 }
 },
 "routes": [{
 "host": "app.example.com", "path": "/*", "frontend": true,
 "backend": "http://app:8080", "auth": {}
 }]
}

item.title: APIs and MCP
item.description:
This example separates the browser session from machine tokens and exposes one MCP service with its protected-resource metadata.

File

examples/protect-api-mcp/routes.json

{
 "authProviders": [
 {
 "id": "mycompany", "type": "oidc",
 "issuer": "https://auth.example.com/t/mycompany",
 "clientId": "gate-one",
 "clientSecretEnv": "MYCOMPANY_OIDC_SECRET",
 "loginBaseUrl": "https://login.example.com",
 "cookieDomain": "example.com",
 "sessionKeyEnv": "MYCOMPANY_SESSION_KEY"
 },
 {
 "id": "mycompany-api", "type": "jwt",
 "issuer": "https://auth.example.com/t/mycompany",
 "jwksUrl": "https://auth.example.com/t/mycompany/jwks.json",
 "audience": "https://api.example.com"
 }
 ],
 "defaultAuthProvider": "mycompany",
 "routes": [
 {
 "host": "app.example.com", "path": "/*", "frontend": true,
 "backend": "http://app:8080", "auth": {}
 },
 {
 "host": "api.example.com", "path": "/v1/*", "backend": "http://api:8080",
 "auth": {
 "provider": "mycompany-api",
 "identity": { "scopes": ["read:things"] }
 }
 },
 {
 "host": "mcp.example.com", "path": "/mcp", "backend": "http://mcp:8080",
 "auth": { "provider": "mycompany-api" },
 "mcp": {
 "enabled": true, "path": "/mcp", "name": "things",
 "resource": "https://mcp.example.com", "scope": "mcp-tools",
 "operations": [{ "name": "list_things", "operationId": "listThings" }]
 }
 }
 ]
}

item.title: HTTP bridge
item.description:
This example connects Gate One to a service implementing the HTTP bridge contract. The bridge can adapt SAML, LDAP, mTLS, API keys or a legacy session service; Gate One only sees /auth, /auth/mcp and /health.

File

examples/http-bridge/routes.json

{
 "authProvider": {
 "type": "http-bridge",
 "baseUrl": "http://legacy-bridge:8080",
 "loginUrl": "https://login.example.com/login",
 "issuer": "https://auth.example.com/realms/example",
 "headers": {
 "userId": "X-User-Id",
 "username": "X-Username",
 "email": "X-Email",
 "roles": "X-Roles",
 "scopes": "X-Scopes",
 "claims": "X-Claims"
 }
 },
 "routes": [{
 "host": "app.example.com", "path": "/*", "frontend": true,
 "backend": "http://app:8080", "auth": {}
 }]
}

item.title: Injectable UX
item.description:
This example runs with the dev provider and demonstrates every injection surface in one route.

Files

  • routes.json

  • bundle.json

  • banner.html

Route

{
 "host": "app.demo.localhost", "path": "/*", "frontend": true,
 "backend": "http://127.0.0.1:8080", "auth": {},
 "inject": "bundle.json",
 "userBadge": {
 "position": "right",
 "claims": ["preferred_username", "email"],
 "roles": ["admin"],
 "logoutLabel": "Sign out"
 },
 "uiGate": [
 { "selector": ".danger-zone", "roles": ["admin"] },
 { "selector": ".beta-feature", "hidden": "before" },
 { "selector": "[data-feature=export]", "auth": "before" }
 ],
 "authGuard": { "forbidden": { "banner": true } },
 "csp": { "mode": "nonce" }
}

item.title: Usage plugin
item.description:
This example runs the dev provider and a reference audit plugin. It is the complete signed-plugin path: manifest, artefact, trust store, WAL and event subscription.

Files

  • routes.json

  • audit.manifest.json

  • trust-store.json

  • audit-echo.placeholder

Route and usage block

{
 "authProvider": {
 "type": "dev",
 "loginBaseUrl": "http://login.demo.localhost:3000",
 "cookieDomain": "demo.localhost"
 },
 "usage": {
 "dir": "./usage-wal",
 "nodeId": "gw-demo-1",
 "budgetBytes": 52428800,
 "subjectSecretEnv": "GATE_ONE_SUBJECT_SECRET",
 "pluginSecretEnv": "GATE_ONE_PLUGIN_SECRET",
 "trustStore": "trust-store.json",
 "types": {
 "auth": { "shareBytes": 10485760, "fsync": "always" },
 "error": { "shareBytes": 10485760, "fsync": "window_ms", "windowMs": 250 }
 },
 "plugins": [{
 "name": "com.cladone.audit",
 "url": "http://127.0.0.1:9100",
 "manifest": "audit.manifest.json",
 "artifact": "audit-echo.placeholder"
 }]
 },
 "routes": [{ "host": "app.demo.localhost", "path": "/*", "frontend": true,
 "backend": "http://127.0.0.1:8080", "auth": {} }]
}
